messages.english: Enter weekly harvest targets and your produce-pack weights in kilograms or pounds.
messages.translation: Nghenisa swikongomelo swa ntshovelo swa vhiki na vhiki ni ntiko wa wena wa maphakete ya ntshovelo hi tikilograma (kg) kumbe tiphawundi ta ntiko (lb).

messages.english: Keep buyer entries when a save cannot be confirmed.
messages.translation: Hlayisa vuxokoxoko bya swilaveko swa vaxavi lebyi u byi ngheniseke byi tshama byi ri kona loko ku hlayisiwa ka byona ku nga koteki ku tiyisisiwa.
Hlawula tiyuniti ta ntiko wa ntshovelo
Kunguhato ra vuhumelerisi → Swikongomelo swa ntshovelo

messages.english: Choose kilograms or pounds, enter your harvest target or your own pack weight, then save. Unknown pack weights stay missing; target totals are planning estimates.
messages.translation: Hlawula tikilograma (kg) kumbe tiphawundi ta ntiko (lb), nghenisa xikongomelo xa wena xa ntshovelo kumbe ntiko wa wena wa phakete ya ntshovelo, kutani u hlayisa. Mintiko ya maphakete leyi nga tiviwiki yi tshama yi nga ri kona; nhlayo hinkwayo ya swikongomelo i vupimanyisi byo kunguhata ntsena.
